-# HomeIQ — AI Real Estate Assistant 🏠
+# Funk Bot
 
-A full-featured AI-powered real estate chatbot built for a boutique Austin, TX real estate agency. Users can search listings, compare properties, and get neighborhood insights — all through a natural language chat interface.
+Funk Bot is a local-first personal assistant workspace. This repository is a **partial implementation**, not the full persistent-agent platform: it provides password-protected, persistent Bot identities and conversations, configurable OpenAI-compatible gateways, model-profile fallback, and reported token usage. It provides two limited audited tools, single-Bot missions and chief-led group missions, but not a computer, autonomous routines, or semantic memory. Do not use it for unattended work or assume it has the safety controls of a complete agent runtime.
 
-## Features
+## Quickstart (Docker Desktop)
 
-- **RAG Architecture** — Retrieval-Augmented Generation retrieves relevant property listings based on each query before sending to the LLM, grounding responses in real inventory
-- **GPT-4o-mini powered** — Fast, cost-efficient responses via OpenAI Chat Completions API
-- **Smart Listing Retrieval** — Keyword + intent-based semantic search across price, bedrooms, neighborhoods, and features
-- **Live Property Sidebar** — Matched listings update dynamically as conversation evolves
-- **Suggested Prompts** — Guided entry points for common buyer questions
-- **Responsive Design** — Mobile-friendly chat, desktop sidebar for listings
-- **Dark luxury UI** — Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
+1. Install and start Docker Desktop. On Windows, enable its WSL 2 backend.
+2. In PowerShell, run `Copy-Item .env.example .env` and `docker compose up --build`.
+3. For a new installation only, open another PowerShell window in the project folder and run `docker compose logs backend`. Find the **first-run setup code**. Open `http://localhost:3000`, enter that code and create a password and Bot. Existing installations retain their password and do not need a setup code.
+4. Open **Settings → Gateways**, save an OpenRouter key (or configure OmniRoute at `http://localhost:20128`), then test the saved connection. Keys are encrypted on disk and never returned by the API.
+5. Check **Model profiles**, then open **Settings → Budget**. Enter the input/output prices per million tokens and token bounds for every profile you use, using the highest prices among its fallback models. No price is assumed. Adjust the default $5/day account and per-Bot limits if needed; monthly limits are optional. Then send your Bot a message.
 
-## Tech Stack
+Docker volumes retain the database, vault key, and OmniRoute data across restarts. For upgrades, rebuild from the same project folder and Compose project name so the existing volumes are reused; do not run `docker compose down -v`, which deletes them. Back up the entire `funk_data` volume: the database and vault key are both needed to recover saved credentials. The OmniRoute container uses the upstream image. Its first start needs network access; check its logs if it fails. Never expose its dashboard publicly.

+Open `http://localhost:3000`. The frontend proxies `/api` to the backend; use `BACKEND_URL` to override the server-side target. Local data lives in `data/`; set `FUNK_DATA_DIR` to change it. `OMNIROUTE_URL` changes the initial default gateway URL. `FUNK_SESSION_SECRET` can override the automatically generated signing key. For HTTPS deployment set `FUNK_SECURE_COOKIE=1`, terminate TLS, and restrict both the application and OmniRoute to trusted users. This is single-user software, not a hardened multi-tenant service. Login attempts have account-wide backoff. A new installation requires a one-time code from the backend logs; anyone with access to those logs or the data directory can set up the account. Do not expose an uninitialized installation to an untrusted network.

+## Character Vault
+
+Open **Settings → Character Vault**, then import a ZIP of PNGs from Sprite Grid Slicer. The importer reads `CharacterName`, `CharacterRole`, `Tags` and `Notes` (and `funk:` equivalents); `CharacterName` or `funk:name` is required. ZIPs are limited to 20 MB, 500 files and 64 MB uncompressed; individual PNGs are limited to 8 MB and 16 megapixels. Invalid files and duplicate names or files are skipped with counts. Names and artwork are not sent to the interface until a character is assigned to a Bot. A new Bot gets a weighted random character without replacement until the draw pool is exhausted; existing Bots and an empty Vault use the built-in shapes. Deleting a Bot returns its character to the available pool if no other Bot has it.
+
+New Bots pick a job preset or custom job, with editable instructions; their name comes from the drawn Vault character, or from the fallback name if the Vault is empty. Existing names and job titles stay unchanged. For an existing Bot without a sprite, open its spotlight and choose **Give me a sprite**; explicitly choose whether to keep the name or adopt the character name. The job title is included in the system prompt. The Vault role is an archetype shown in the spotlight, not a job title.
+
+Character images are stored in the same private data volume as the database; back up the whole volume. Image routes require login and a Bot assignment. Files on your own machine cannot be hidden from an administrator with filesystem access. There is no CLI, reroll, per-character animation map or bulk editing in this slice. Imported notes are shown on reveal but are not automatically injected into prompts.

+## Team Command Center and Office
 
-## Getting Started
+**Gallery** is the home view. It shows assigned characters only; unassigned Vault art stays hidden. Search Bots or switch grid/list/cluster layout; the sidebar is a flat Bot list. At import, an optional collection tag is added to each newly imported character; duplicates are not modified. An untagged Bot appears in Uncategorized. The gallery paginates 60 Bots at a time and virtualizes visible rows; the sidebar limits its displayed Bot lists to 50, so use search to narrow them. Bot metadata is still fetched in one request, not server-paginated.
 
-### Prerequisites
-- Node.js v18+
-- OpenAI API key
+Select a Bot to open its spotlight and chat. Duplicate Bot copies the identity, profile, sprite assignment and Bot-specific budget limits; it does not copy conversations, memories, activity, missions or workspace files. Skills and routines do not yet exist. To remove it, select **Delete Bot** and confirm; its conversation and recorded activity are permanently deleted, while its assigned sprite stays in the Vault. A Bot with a run in progress cannot be deleted until the run ends. Quick Mission creates a real single-Bot mission for the selected Bot. The Activity panel and status indicators come from recorded events. Runs today means `run.started` events since local midnight, not a count of historic runs that predate the event log. Last activity is the latest surviving event. No uptime or mission count is calculated. Upload or remove a private banner under **Settings → Appearance**; otherwise a gradient is shown. The recommended banner size is 2400 × 600. The entire banner image is fitted without cropping; any previously saved placement is retained but not applied. The hero contracts while scrolling and expands again when the content returns to the top.

-## Customization
+### Analytics, Lab and memory
 
-**Add listings:** Edit `src/services/listings.ts` — add properties to the `LISTINGS` array.
+Analytics groups real runs and model rounds by their UTC start date, and approval decisions by decision date. Latency includes time waiting for approvals; the error rate counts failed runs among terminal runs (including cancellations). Costs are ledger estimates based on configured prices, not provider invoices. Pending or uncertain charges are counted separately and excluded from spend. Older usage without a linked reservation is shown under an unknown profile. CSV contains the same rows.
 
-**Swap AI provider:** Replace `src/services/openai.ts` with any OpenAI-compatible API (Anthropic, Gemini, etc.).
+Lab compares up to three configured profiles sequentially. Each call reserves budget and is counted in the ledger. It sends the tested prompt without Bot conversation history, memory or tools, and rejects unexpected tool calls. Lab runs do not add chat messages or write workspace files. A completed test can explicitly replace the Bot personality or save its results as a project note. A restart marks unfinished tests failed. It cannot prevent a model provider from storing a request; check that provider's policies.
 
-**Production RAG:** Replace the keyword retrieval in `retrieveRelevantListings()` with embedding-based vector search via Pinecone.
+Per-Bot memory is managed in Lab. After a successful direct chat, a narrow local rule captures a standalone “I prefer …” or “Remember that …” message, with its source and date. It does not extract general facts, process mission or tool content, or automatically update shared/project memory. You can manually add, edit and delete shared facts and project facts in Lab; shared facts apply to every Bot, and project facts apply only to linked missions. Both are untrusted model context, and only owner actions can change them. Entries containing recognized secrets are skipped. Entries can be edited, deleted and pinned, with a maximum of 50 entries, 4,000 characters per entry and 32,000 characters per Bot. Normal runs include up to 8,000 characters, pinned then most recent; the memory is described to the model as untrusted data. Known gateway keys and common secret patterns are redacted before storage, but redaction is not guaranteed: never put sensitive information in memory. Deleting a Bot deletes its memory.
 
-## License
+## Current behavior and limitations
 
-MIT
+**Budget safeguards are not a guarantee of provider billing.** Funk Bot reserves against account and per-Bot daily/monthly caps before chat requests, but it depends on accurate configured prices, a conservative input-token bound, and the gateway honoring output limits and reporting usage. Tokenization overhead, gateway-added charges, incorrect prices, providers that ignore limits, and spending outside Funk Bot can exceed these estimates. Always set provider-side limits and do not leave runs unattended.
 
----
+Open **Settings → Budget** to set caps and profile prices. The account and each Bot default to $5/day; monthly limits are disabled until configured. Periods use UTC. Each model round, including a follow-up after a tool call, reserves for every possible fallback; no configured price means the run is refused. Costs for new runs are calculated from reported input/output tokens and the profile's configured prices, not inferred from a model name. If an attempt fails, is interrupted, exceeds configured token bounds, or does not report usage, further spending is blocked until you verify its total in your gateway billing and enter the charge and source in Budget. These owner-supplied corrections are audited. Old usage without a cost must likewise be reconciled when it falls within a capped period. Existing Bots, keys, sprites and messages are not deleted by the budget migrations.
 
-Built by [CFunk Creations LLC](mailto:cfunkycreations@gmail.com) — Austin, TX
+- Projects contain an optional owner, project notes and links to existing missions. Mission totals come from linked runs and may be awaiting verification. The read-only workspace view shows flat `.txt` files belonging to the owner or linked mission assignees; these files remain Bot-local and can appear in multiple projects. Previews are limited to 64 KB and require secure descriptor-based file access (use Docker where unsupported). Unlinking a mission does not delete it or its files.
+- The Missions list shows the 100 most recent missions. A group contains two to six Bots including a Chief of Staff; the chief produces a structured plan, each member works sequentially, and the chief synthesizes the actual replies. Invalid plans fail rather than inventing delegation. Each run uses the same approvals and budgets as chat. Group membership is copied into a mission at creation. A queued mission starts when its Bot becomes free. Its result, cost and run events come from the actual run, and tool approvals use the same safety controls as chat. A restart marks unfinished missions failed rather than silently replaying them; check for completed tool side effects before retrying. Quick Mission creates a real mission.
+- Each Bot has its own stored timeline and identity. The last 40 messages are sent as context; this is conversation history, not semantic memory. Deleting a Bot deletes its messages.
+- The database uses SQLAlchemy connections with Alembic migrations, adopting existing slice databases without replacing their rows. SQL queries and migrations remain SQLite-specific; PostgreSQL support is not implemented. Back up the full data volume before upgrading.
+- Chat runs in the backend and can finish after the browser closes, provided the backend keeps running. Run records and streamed events are stored in SQLite. Reopening a Bot reconnects to an active run; after a backend restart, unfinished runs are marked failed and surfaced in that Bot’s chat rather than automatically resumed. Run the backend with one worker only. Provider text streams through a sliding-window redactor for saved gateway keys and common key patterns. The filter deliberately delays a small tail of text and cannot detect all possible secrets.
+- Profiles attempt entries in order for rate limits, server failures, connection errors, and empty responses. Client errors and partially emitted responses stop the chain. The gateway and selected model must support OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls. If a prior attempt may have incurred an unknown charge, no tools are executed and the charge must be reconciled before more spending.
+- Bots can request `web_fetch` and `write_note`; there is no shell tool. Web access is default-deny; configure exact hosts or domain suffixes in **Settings → Web access**. Deny rules override allow rules, every resolved address must be public, connections use the validated address, redirects/compression are refused, and requests are limited to 256 KiB and 10 seconds. Web pages remain untrusted and can contain misleading or malicious instructions; these safeguards are not a complete defense against prompt injection.
+- `write_note` creates a new `.txt` file only within the individual Bot's workspace. The owner sees the redacted arguments that will actually execute and must choose **Approve once**, **Approve for this response** (same tool only, current run only), or **Deny**. Review the entire content before approving. Tool activity appears in chat and **Settings → Tool audit**. A pending approval can be stopped; an interrupted or restarted run is never replayed automatically. A completed tool action is not undone if a subsequent model round exceeds a cap or fails. Deleting a Bot deletes its tool audit and conversation, but leaves mission records and its workspace note files on disk and returns its sprite to the Vault. Redaction is heuristic, not a guarantee that secrets are removed.
+- Token totals come from reported usage. Known costs include configured-price token charges and owner-reconciled amounts; unknown charges are disclosed rather than treated as free. Caps are reservation-based estimates, not provider-enforced billing limits.
+- Vault encryption protects database contents from casual inspection, but its key is stored alongside the data on the same host. Protect filesystem access and backups. Messages and provider output are redacted for saved gateway keys and common key patterns; no redaction is perfect.
+- The authenticated `/api/events?since=0` endpoint exposes cursor-ordered run starts, message summaries, state changes, errors, and finishes recorded after this upgrade. Existing slice-2 events remain in per-run history and are not backfilled. Deleting a Bot deletes its event history. This is not a complete audit log. Beyond the two tools described above, no general search or file access, MCP, scheduler, webhook, sandbox, notifications, PWA, export, or browser/computer features are provided. The UI intentionally does not advertise those as working.
+- Provider names and defaults are configuration examples, not a guarantee that models are currently available. A working account/key and gateway configuration are required for live inference.

+DATA = Path(os.environ.get('FUNK_DATA_DIR', Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'data'))
+DATA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+def get_or_create_key(name, factory):
+    path = DATA / name
+    try:
+        with path.open('x') as f:
+            os.chmod(path, 0o600)
+            f.write(factory())
+    except FileExistsError:
+        pass
+    return path.read_text().strip()
+
+cipher = Fernet(get_or_create_key('vault.key', lambda: Fernet.generate_key().decode()).encode())
+session_secret = os.environ.get('FUNK_SESSION_SECRET') or get_or_create_key('session.key', lambda: secrets.token_urlsafe(48))
+signer = URLSafeTimedSerializer(session_secret, salt='funk-session')
+ph = PasswordHasher()
+DB = DATA / 'funk.db'
+
+def db():
+    return session(DB)
+
+def init_db():
+    migrate(DB)
+    with db() as c:
+        defaults = {
+            'gateways': json.dumps({'omniroute': {'url': os.getenv('OMNIROUTE_URL', 'http://localhost:20128/v1'), 'key': ''}, 'openrouter': {'url':'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1', 'key':''}, 'custom': {'url':'', 'key':''}}),
+            'profiles': json.dumps({'fast': [{'gateway':'omniroute','model':'auto'}], 'smart': [{'gateway':'openrouter','model':'openai/gpt-4o-mini'}, {'gateway':'omniroute','model':'auto'}], 'thinker': [{'gateway':'openrouter','model':'openai/o3-mini'}], 'vision': [{'gateway':'openrouter','model':'openai/gpt-4o-mini'}], 'cheap-bulk': [{'gateway':'omniroute','model':'auto'}]})
+        }
+        for k,v in defaults.items(): c.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO config VALUES (?,?)',(k,v))
+
+def config(key, fallback=None):
+    with db() as c:
+        row = c.execute('SELECT value FROM config WHERE key=?',(key,)).fetchone()
+    return row['value'] if row else fallback
+
+def set_config(key, value):
+    with db() as c: c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO config VALUES (?,?)',(key,value))
+
+def configured_secrets():
+    found = []
+    for gateway in json.loads(config('gateways','{}')).values():
+        try:
+            if gateway.get('key'):
+                found.append(cipher.decrypt(gateway['key'].encode()).decode())
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    return found
+
+def redact(text):
+    return redact_text(text, configured_secrets())
+
+def require_auth(request: Request):
+    try:
+        if signer.loads(request.cookies.get('funk_session',''), max_age=60*60*24*30) != 'owner': raise BadSignature('invalid')
+    except BadSignature: raise HTTPException(401, 'Please sign in.')
+
+def validate_url(url):
+    parsed = urlparse(url)
+    if parsed.scheme not in ('http','https') or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
+        raise HTTPException(400, 'Enter a valid HTTP(S) gateway URL without credentials.')
+    return url.rstrip('/')
+
+init_db()
+
+@asynccontextmanager
+async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
+    # Only new installations need the one-time code. Existing volumes keep working.
+    mark_interrupted_runs()
+    if config('password_hash') is None:
+        token = ensure_setup_token(DATA)
+        logging.getLogger('uvicorn.error').warning(
+            'Funk Bot first-run setup code (enter this in the setup screen): %s', token
+        )
+    yield
+
+app = FastAPI(title='Funk Bot', lifespan=lifespan)
+jobs = {}
+mission_tasks = {}
+lab_tasks = {}

+class Password(BaseModel):
+    password: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=256)
+
+class SetupPassword(Password):
+    setup_token: str = Field(default='', max_length=256)
+
+@app.get('/api/auth/status')
+def auth_status(request: Request):
+    authenticated = True
+    try: require_auth(request)
+    except HTTPException: authenticated = False
+    return {'setup': config('password_hash') is not None, 'authenticated': authenticated}
+
+@app.post('/api/auth/setup')
+def setup(body: SetupPassword, response: Response):
+    # Do not reveal the setup code via the API. The file is readable only to
+    # the installation owner; the code is printed to the backend startup log.
+    if config('password_hash') is not None:
+        raise HTTPException(409, 'Setup is already complete.')
+    token_file = DATA / 'setup.token'
+    try:
+        expected = token_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        raise HTTPException(503, 'Setup code unavailable. Restart the backend.')
+    if not body.setup_token or not secrets.compare_digest(expected, body.setup_token):
+        raise HTTPException(403, 'Incorrect setup code. Check the backend logs.')
+    with db() as c:
+        try: c.execute('INSERT INTO config VALUES (?,?)', ('password_hash', ph.hash(body.password)))
+        except IntegrityError: raise HTTPException(409, 'Setup is already complete.')
+    token_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    response.set_cookie('funk_session', signer.dumps('owner'), httponly=True, samesite='strict', max_age=2592000, secure=os.getenv('FUNK_SECURE_COOKIE') == '1')
+    return {'ok': True}
+
+@app.post('/api/auth/login')
+def login(body: Password, response: Response):
+    # The account-wide guard is stored in SQLite, not keyed by a proxy-provided
+    # IP. BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes attempts across threads and processes.
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        guard = c.execute('SELECT failures, locked_until FROM login_guard WHERE id=1').fetchone()
+        remaining = guard['locked_until'] - time.time()
+        if remaining > 0:
+            c.commit()
+            raise HTTPException(429, 'Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.', headers={'Retry-After': str(max(1, int(remaining) + 1))})
+        row = c.execute('SELECT value FROM config WHERE key=?', ('password_hash',)).fetchone()
+        valid = False
+        try:
+            valid = bool(row and ph.verify(row['value'], body.password))
+        except (VerifyMismatchError, VerificationError):
+            pass
+        if not valid:
+            failures = guard['failures'] + 1
+            c.execute('UPDATE login_guard SET failures=?, locked_until=? WHERE id=1', (failures, time.time() + lockout_seconds(failures)))
+            c.commit()
+            raise HTTPException(401, 'Incorrect password.')
+        c.execute('UPDATE login_guard SET failures=0, locked_until=0 WHERE id=1')
+        c.commit()
+    response.set_cookie('funk_session', signer.dumps('owner'), httponly=True, samesite='strict', max_age=2592000, secure=os.getenv('FUNK_SECURE_COOKIE') == '1')
+    return {'ok': True}
+
+@app.post('/api/auth/logout')
+def logout(response: Response):
+    response.delete_cookie('funk_session')
+    return {'ok':True}
+
+class BotIn(BaseModel):
+    name: str = Field(default='New Bot', min_length=1,max_length=120)
+    title: str = Field(default='Personal assistant', max_length=100)
+    personality: str = Field(default='You are a helpful, thoughtful personal assistant.', max_length=6000)
+    color: str = Field(default='lavender', pattern='^(lavender|peach|mint|blue|yellow)$')
+    shape: str = Field(default='round', pattern='^(round|square|cloud)$')
+    profile: str = Field(default='smart', pattern='^(fast|smart|thinker|vision|cheap-bulk)$')
+
+def redact_character(character, keys):
+    # Gateway keys saved after an import must not leak through old metadata.
+    for field in ('name', 'role', 'notes'):
+        character[field] = redact_text(character[field], keys)
+    character['tags'] = [redact_text(tag, keys) for tag in character['tags']]
+    return character
+
+@app.get('/api/bots')
+def bots(request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        rows = c.execute("""SELECT b.*, (SELECT content FROM messages m WHERE m.bot_id=b.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as latest,
+                            ch.name as character_name, ch.role as character_role, ch.tags as character_tags,
+                            ch.notes as character_notes, ch.rarity as character_rarity
+                            FROM bots b LEFT JOIN bot_characters bc ON bc.bot_id=b.id
+                            LEFT JOIN characters ch ON ch.id=bc.character_id ORDER BY b.created_at""").fetchall()
+    result=[]
+    keys=configured_secrets()
+    for row in rows:
+        item=dict(row)
+        for field in ('name','title','personality','latest'):
+            if item[field] is not None:
+                item[field] = redact_text(item[field], keys)
+        character = None
+        if item['character_name'] is not None:
+            character=character_for_bot({'name':item['character_name'], 'role':item['character_role'], 'tags':item['character_tags'],
+                                         'notes':item['character_notes'], 'rarity':item['character_rarity']}, item['id'])
+            character = redact_character(character, keys)
+        for field in ('character_name','character_role','character_tags','character_notes','character_rarity'):
+            item.pop(field)
+        item['character']=character
+        result.append(item)
+    return result
+
+@app.post('/api/bots')
+def create_bot(body: BotIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    name,title,personality=redact(body.name.strip()),redact(body.title.strip()),redact(body.personality)
+    keys=configured_secrets()
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        id = str(uuid.uuid4())
+        c.execute('INSERT INTO bots VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(id,name,title,personality,body.color,body.shape,body.profile,time.time()))
+        character=draw_character(c,id)
+        if character:
+            c.execute('UPDATE bots SET name=? WHERE id=?', (redact_text(character['name'], keys),id))
+    return {'id':id,'character':redact_character(character, configured_secrets()) if character else None}
+
+
+@app.post('/api/bots/{bot_id}/duplicate')
+def duplicate_bot(bot_id: str, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    keys=configured_secrets();new_id=str(uuid.uuid4());now=time.time()
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        bot=c.execute('SELECT * FROM bots WHERE id=?',(bot_id,)).fetchone()
+        if not bot: raise HTTPException(404,'Bot not found.')
+        name=redact_text(bot['name'],keys)[:113]+' (copy)'
+        c.execute('INSERT INTO bots VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(new_id,name,redact_text(bot['title'],keys),redact_text(bot['personality'],keys),bot['color'],bot['shape'],bot['profile'],now))
+        character=c.execute('SELECT character_id FROM bot_characters WHERE bot_id=?',(bot_id,)).fetchone()
+        if character:
+            c.execute('INSERT INTO bot_characters VALUES (?,?,?)',(new_id,character['character_id'],now))
+        limit=c.execute('SELECT daily_nanos,monthly_nanos FROM budget_limits WHERE scope=?',('bot:'+bot_id,)).fetchone()
+        if limit:
+            c.execute('INSERT INTO budget_limits VALUES (?,?,?)',('bot:'+new_id,limit['daily_nanos'],limit['monthly_nanos']))
+    return {'id':new_id}

+class SpriteChoice(BaseModel):
+    adopt_character_name: bool
+

+@app.post('/api/bots/{bot_id}/sprite')
+def give_sprite(bot_id: str, body: SpriteChoice, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    keys = configured_secrets()
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        if not c.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bots WHERE id=?', (bot_id,)).fetchone():
+            raise HTTPException(404, 'Bot not found.')
+        if c.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bot_characters WHERE bot_id=?', (bot_id,)).fetchone():
+            raise HTTPException(409, 'This Bot already has a sprite. Its existing sprite was not changed.')
+        character = draw_character(c, bot_id)
+        if not character:
+            raise HTTPException(409, 'The Character Vault is empty. Import characters first.')
+        character = redact_character(character, keys)
+        if body.adopt_character_name:
+            c.execute('UPDATE bots SET name=? WHERE id=?', (character['name'], bot_id))
+    return {'character':character}

+@app.put('/api/bots/{bot_id}')
+def update_bot(bot_id: str, body: BotIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        cur=c.execute('UPDATE bots SET name=?, title=?, personality=?, color=?, shape=?, profile=? WHERE id=?',(redact(body.name.strip()),redact(body.title.strip()),redact(body.personality),body.color,body.shape,body.profile,bot_id))
+        if not cur.rowcount: raise HTTPException(404,'Bot not found.')
+    return {'ok':True}

+@app.delete('/api/bots/{bot_id}')
+def delete_bot(bot_id: str, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        if c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE bot_id=? AND status IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval')", (bot_id,)).fetchone(): raise HTTPException(409, 'Wait for the current response before deleting this Bot.')
+        if c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM lab_experiments WHERE bot_id=? AND status IN ('queued','running')",(bot_id,)).fetchone(): raise HTTPException(409,'This Bot has an active Lab experiment.')
+        if c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM missions JOIN mission_assignees ON mission_assignees.mission_id=missions.id WHERE mission_assignees.bot_id=? AND missions.status IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval')",(bot_id,)).fetchone():
+            raise HTTPException(409,'Cancel the active or queued mission before deleting this Bot.')
+        assignment=c.execute('SELECT character_id FROM bot_characters WHERE bot_id=?',(bot_id,)).fetchone()
+        # Tool audit has no foreign keys in the additive legacy schema. Delete
+        # it explicitly, matching the confirmation that recorded activity goes.
+        c.execute('DELETE FROM tool_audit WHERE call_id IN (SELECT id FROM tool_calls WHERE bot_id=?)',(bot_id,))
+        c.execute('DELETE FROM tool_calls WHERE bot_id=?',(bot_id,))
+        if not c.execute('DELETE FROM bots WHERE id=?',(bot_id,)).rowcount: raise HTTPException(404,'Bot not found.')
+        if assignment and not c.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bot_characters WHERE character_id=?',(assignment['character_id'],)).fetchone():
+            c.execute('UPDATE characters SET drawn=0 WHERE id=?',(assignment['character_id'],))
+    return {'ok':True}
+
+@app.get('/api/bots/{bot_id}/avatar')
+def bot_avatar(bot_id: str, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        row=c.execute('SELECT character_id FROM bot_characters WHERE bot_id=?',(bot_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not row: raise HTTPException(404, 'Character not found.')
+    path=DATA / 'vault' / (row['character_id'] + '.png')
+    if not path.is_file(): raise HTTPException(404, 'Character artwork is missing.')
+    return FileResponse(path, media_type='image/png', headers={'Cache-Control':'private, no-store','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff'})

+@app.get('/api/vault/status')
+def vault_status(request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        row=c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN drawn=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as available FROM characters').fetchone()

+@app.post('/api/vault/import')
+async def vault_import(request: Request, file: UploadFile = File(...), collection: str = Form(default="", max_length=60)):
+    require_auth(request)
+    try:
+        data=await file.read(MAX_ARCHIVE+1)
+        if len(data)>MAX_ARCHIVE: raise VaultError('ZIP is too large (maximum 20 MB).')
+        keys=configured_secrets()
+        with db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+            result=import_zip(data,c,DATA / 'vault',keys,collection.strip())
+        return result
+    except VaultError as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(400,str(exc)) from exc
+    finally:
+        await file.close()

+class GatewayIn(BaseModel):
+    url: str
+    key: str | None = None
+    clear_key: bool = False
+
+@app.get('/api/settings')
+def settings(request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    gateways=json.loads(config('gateways'))
+    for g in gateways.values():
+        g['has_key']=bool(g.pop('key', ''))
+    with db() as c:
+        usage=dict(c.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens),0) as prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens),0) as completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost),0) as cost FROM usage').fetchone())
+        usage['cost'] += c.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_nanos),0) FROM budget_reconciliations WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL').fetchone()[0] / NANOS_PER_DOLLAR
+        usage['unknown'] = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_reservations WHERE status='uncertain'").fetchone()[0] + c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage WHERE cost IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE budget_reservations.usage_id=usage.id)").fetchone()[0]
+    return {'gateways':gateways, 'profiles':json.loads(config('profiles')), 'usage':usage}
+
+@app.put('/api/settings/gateways/{name}')
+def save_gateway(name: str, body: GatewayIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    gateways=json.loads(config('gateways'))
+    if name not in gateways: raise HTTPException(404,'Gateway not found.')
+    gateways[name]['url']=validate_url(body.url) if body.url else ''
+    if body.clear_key: gateways[name]['key']=''
+    elif body.key: gateways[name]['key']=cipher.encrypt(body.key.encode()).decode()
+    set_config('gateways',json.dumps(gateways))
+    return {'ok':True}
+
+class ProfileEntry(BaseModel):
+    gateway: str = Field(pattern='^(omniroute|openrouter|custom)$')
+    model: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=200)
+
+@app.put('/api/settings/profiles')
+def save_profiles(body: dict[str,list[ProfileEntry]], request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    if set(body) != {'fast','smart','thinker','vision','cheap-bulk'} or any(not v or len(v)>10 for v in body.values()): raise HTTPException(400,'Each profile needs one to ten models.')
+    set_config('profiles',json.dumps({k:[x.model_dump() for x in v] for k,v in body.items()}))
+    return {'ok':True}
+
+def gateway_config(name):
+    g=json.loads(config('gateways'))[name]
+    if not g['url']: raise ValueError('Gateway URL is not configured')
+    key=cipher.decrypt(g['key'].encode()).decode() if g['key'] else ''
+    return g['url'], {'Authorization':f'Bearer {key}'} if key else {}
+
+@app.get('/api/settings/gateways/{name}/models')
+async def models(name: str, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    if name not in ('omniroute','openrouter','custom'): raise HTTPException(404, 'Gateway not found.')
+    try:
+        url, headers=gateway_config(name)
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=12, follow_redirects=False) as client:
+            result=await client.get(url+'/models',headers=headers)
+            result.raise_for_status()
+        return {'models': [x['id'] for x in result.json().get('data',[]) if isinstance(x,dict) and isinstance(x.get('id'),str)][:1000]}
+    except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(502, 'Could not reach gateway. Check its URL and credentials.') from e
+
+PROFILES = {'fast', 'smart', 'thinker', 'vision', 'cheap-bulk'}

+def nano_string(value):
+    return str(Decimal(value) / Decimal(NANOS_PER_DOLLAR))
+
+
+@app.get('/api/budget')
+def get_budget(request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        account = limits_for(c, 'account')
+        bots = {row['scope'][4:]: {'daily': nano_string(row['daily_nanos']), 'monthly': None if row['monthly_nanos'] is None else nano_string(row['monthly_nanos'])} for row in c.execute("SELECT * FROM budget_limits WHERE scope LIKE 'bot:%'")}
+        prices = {row['profile']: {'prompt': row['prompt_usd_per_million'], 'completion': row['completion_usd_per_million'], 'max_prompt_tokens': row['max_prompt_tokens'], 'max_completion_tokens': row['max_completion_tokens']} for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM budget_prices')}
+        uncertain = [dict(row) for row in c.execute("SELECT run_id,bot_id,profile,created_at FROM budget_reservations WHERE status='uncertain' ORDER BY created_at DESC")]
+        unknown = [dict(row) for row in c.execute("SELECT id,bot_id,gateway,model,created_at FROM usage WHERE cost IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE budget_reservations.usage_id=usage.id) ORDER BY created_at DESC")]
+    keys=configured_secrets()
+    for row in unknown:
+        for field in ('gateway','model'):
+            if row[field] is not None: row[field]=redact_text(row[field],keys)
+    return {'account': {'daily': nano_string(account[0]), 'monthly': None if account[1] is None else nano_string(account[1])}, 'bots': bots, 'prices': prices, 'unreconciled': uncertain, 'unknown_usage': unknown}
+
+
+@app.put('/api/budget/limits/{scope}')
+def put_budget_limits(scope: str, body: BudgetLimitsIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    if scope != 'account' and not scope.startswith('bot:'): raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid budget scope.')
+    try:
+        daily = limit_to_nanos(body.daily)
+        monthly = None if body.monthly is None else limit_to_nanos(body.monthly)
+    except BudgetError as exc: raise HTTPException(400, str(exc)) from exc
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        if scope.startswith('bot:') and not c.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bots WHERE id=?', (scope[4:],)).fetchone(): raise HTTPException(404, 'Bot not found.')
+        c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO budget_limits VALUES (?,?,?)', (scope,daily,monthly))
+    return {'ok': True}
+
+
+@app.put('/api/budget/prices/{profile}')
+def put_budget_price(profile: str, body: BudgetPriceIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    if profile not in PROFILES: raise HTTPException(404, 'Profile not found.')
+    try:
+        token_cost_nanos(body.max_prompt_tokens,body.max_completion_tokens,body.prompt,body.completion)
+    except BudgetError as exc: raise HTTPException(400,str(exc)) from exc
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO budget_prices VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', (profile,body.prompt,body.completion,body.max_prompt_tokens,body.max_completion_tokens))
+    return {'ok': True}
+
+
+@app.post('/api/budget/reconcile/{kind}/{identifier}')
+def reconcile_budget(kind: str, identifier: str, body: BudgetCorrectionIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    source = redact(body.source)
+    try:
+        with db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+            if kind == 'run': reconcile_run(c,identifier,body.amount,source)
+            elif kind == 'usage' and identifier.isdigit(): reconcile_usage(c,int(identifier),body.amount,source)
+            else: raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid correction target.')
+    except BudgetError as exc: raise HTTPException(400, str(exc)) from exc
+    return {'ok': True}
